     1	# 📡 Messaging Backend Architecture (Final - With RabbitMQ)
     2	
     3	---
     4	
     5	# 🚀 Overview
     6	
     7	System now includes:
     8	
     9	* ✅ 1–1 Chat
    10	* ✅ Group Chat
    11	* ✅ WebSocket (STOMP)
    12	* ✅ RabbitMQ (async processing)
    13	* ✅ Cassandra (message storage)
    14	* ✅ PostgreSQL (relationships)
    15	
    16	---
    17	![Architecture](./Pigeon-Messaging-architecture.png)
    18	
    19	---
    20	
    21	# 🧠 Why RabbitMQ?
    22	
    23	Without RabbitMQ:
    24	
    25	```text
    26	WebSocket → DB → Broadcast
    27	```
    28	
    29	---
    30	
    31	With RabbitMQ:
    32	
    33	```text
    34	WebSocket → Queue → Worker → DB → Broadcast
    35	```
    36	
    37	✅ Benefits:
    38	
    39	* Async processing
    40	* Scalable workers
    41	* Retry mechanism
    42	* Fault tolerance
    43	
    44	---
    45	
    46	# 🏗️ FINAL VISUAL ARCHITECTURE
    47	
    48	```id="arch1"
    49	Sender Client
    50	      │
    51	      ▼
    52	WebSocket (STOMP)
    53	      │
    54	      ▼
    55	Spring Controller
    56	      │
    57	      ▼
    58	RabbitMQ Exchange
    59	      │
    60	 ┌──────────────┐
    61	 │ MessageWorker│
    62	 └──────────────┘
    63	      │
    64	      ├── Store Message (Cassandra)
    65	      ├── Push to Receiver (WebSocket)
    66	      └── Send Status Updates
    67	```
    68	
    69	---
    70	
    71	# 📡 FLOW (1–1 CHAT)
    72	
    73	```id="flow1"
    74	User → /app/chat.send
    75	     ↓
    76	ChatController
    77	     ↓
    78	Publish → RabbitMQ (chat.exchange)
    79	     ↓
    80	MessageWorker consumes
    81	     ↓
    82	Save → Cassandra (messages table)
    83	     ↓
    84	Send → /topic/conversation/{conversationId}
    85	     ↓
    86	Receiver gets message
    87	```
    88	
    89	---
    90	
    91	# 📡 FLOW (GROUP CHAT)
    92	
    93	```id="flow2"
    94	User → /app/group.send
    95	     ↓
    96	GroupChatController
    97	     ↓
    98	Publish → RabbitMQ (group.exchange)
    99	     ↓
   100	MessageWorker
   101	     ↓
   102	Save → Cassandra (group_messages)
   103	     ↓
   104	Publish → /topic/group/{groupId}
   105	     ↓
   106	All members receive
   107	```
   108	
   109	---
   110	
   111	# 🐰 RabbitMQ DESIGN
   112	
   113	## Exchange
   114	
   115	```id="ex1"
   116	chat.exchange
   117	group.exchange
   118	```
   119	
   120	---
   121	
   122	## Queue
   123	
   124	```id="q1"
   125	chat.queue
   126	group.queue
   127	```
   128	
   129	---
   130	
   131	## Routing Key
   132	
   133	```id="rk1"
   134	chat.message
   135	group.message
   136	```
   137	
   138	---
   139	
   140	## 2️⃣ Config
   141	
   142	```java id="cfg1"
   143	@Bean
   144	public TopicExchange chatExchange() {
   145	    return new TopicExchange("chat.exchange");
   146	}
   147	
   148	@Bean
   149	public Queue chatQueue() {
   150	    return new Queue("chat.queue");
   151	}
   152	
   153	@Bean
   154	public Binding binding() {
   155	    return BindingBuilder
   156	            .bind(chatQueue())
   157	            .to(chatExchange())
   158	            .with("chat.message");
   159	}
   160	```
   161	
   162	---
   163	
   164	## 3️⃣ Producer (Controller → RabbitMQ)
   165	
   166	```java id="prod1"
   167	@Autowired
   168	private RabbitTemplate rabbitTemplate;
   169	
   170	rabbitTemplate.convertAndSend(
   171	    "chat.exchange",
   172	    "chat.message",
   173	    messageDto
   174	);
   175	```
   176	
   177	---
   178	
   179	## 4️⃣ Consumer (Worker)
   180	
   181	```java id="cons1"
   182	@RabbitListener(queues = "chat.queue")
   183	public void consumeMessage(ChatMessageRequest msg) {
   184	
   185	    // 1. Save to Cassandra
   186	    messageService.save(msg);
   187	
   188	    // 2. Push to WebSocket
   189	    messagingTemplate.convertAndSend(
   190	        "/topic/conversation/" + msg.getConversationId(),
   191	        msg
   192	    );
   193	}
   194	```
   195	
   196	---
   197	
   198	# 🧱 FULL MESSAGE LIFECYCLE
   199	
   200	```id="life1"
   201	1. User sends message
   202	2. WebSocket receives
   203	3. Controller publishes to RabbitMQ
   204	4. Queue stores message
   205	5. Worker consumes message
   206	6. Save in Cassandra
   207	7. Broadcast via WebSocket
   208	8. Receiver gets message
   209	9. Status update triggered
   210	```
   211	
   212	---
   213	
   214	# 🔥 ADVANCED (Production Ready)
   215	
   216	## Multiple Workers
   217	
   218	```id="adv1"
   219	chat.worker.1
   220	chat.worker.2
   221	chat.worker.3
   222	```
   223	
   224	✔ Load balancing
   225	✔ High throughput
   226	
   227	---
   228	
   229	## Retry Mechanism
   230	
   231	```id="adv2"
   232	Main Queue → Dead Letter Queue (DLQ)
   233	```
   234	
   235	---
   236	
   237	## Message Status Flow
   238	
   239	```id="adv3"
   240	SENT → when pushed to queue
   241	DELIVERED → when consumer processes
   242	SEEN → when client acknowledges
   243	```
   244	
   245	---
   246	
   247	# ⚠️ IMPORTANT DESIGN RULE
   248	
   249	👉 NEVER do this:
   250	
   251	```text
   252	Controller → DB directly
   253	```
   254	
   255	👉 ALWAYS:
   256	
   257	```text
   258	Controller → RabbitMQ → Worker → DB
   259	```
   260	
   261	---
   262	
   263	# 🎯 FINAL ARCHITECTURE SUMMARY
   264	
   265	```id="final1"
   266	Client
   267	  ↓
   268	WebSocket
   269	  ↓
   270	Controller
   271	  ↓
   272	RabbitMQ
   273	  ↓
   274	Worker
   275	  ↓
   276	Cassandra
   277	  ↓
   278	WebSocket Broadcast
   279	```
   280

     2	# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

    21	# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    22	# Apache Maven Wrapper startup batch script, version 3.3.4
    23	#
    24	# Optional ENV vars
    25	# -----------------
    26	#   JAVA_HOME - location of a JDK home dir, required when download maven via java source
    27	#   MVNW_REPOURL - repo url base for downloading maven distribution
    28	#   MVNW_USERNAME/MVNW_PASSWORD - user and password for downloading maven
    29	#   MVNW_VERBOSE - true: enable verbose log; debug: trace the mvnw script; others: silence the output
    30	# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    31	
    32	set -euf
    33	[ "${MVNW_VERBOSE-}" != debug ] || set -x
    34	
    35	# OS specific support.
    36	native_path() { printf %s\\n "$1"; }
    37	case "$(uname)" in
    38	CYGWIN* | MINGW*)
    39	  [ -z "${JAVA_HOME-}" ] || JAVA_HOME="$(cygpath --unix "$JAVA_HOME")"
    40	  native_path() { cygpath --path --windows "$1"; }
    41	  ;;
    42	esac
    43	
    44	# set JAVACMD and JAVACCMD
    45	set_java_home() {
    46	  # For Cygwin and MinGW, ensure paths are in Unix format before anything is touched
    47	  if [ -n "${JAVA_HOME-}" ]; then
    48	    if [ -x "$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java" ]; then
    49	      # IBM's JDK on AIX uses strange locations for the executables
    50	      JAVACMD="$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java"
    51	      JAVACCMD="$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/javac"
    52	    else
    53	      JAVACMD="$JAVA_HOME/bin/java"
    54	      JAVACCMD="$JAVA_HOME/bin/javac"
    55	
    56	      if [ ! -x "$JAVACMD" ] || [ ! -x "$JAVACCMD" ]; then
    57	        echo "The JAVA_HOME environment variable is not defined correctly, so mvnw cannot run." >&2
    58	        echo "JAVA_HOME is set to \"$JAVA_HOME\", but \"\$JAVA_HOME/bin/java\" or \"\$JAVA_HOME/bin/javac\" does not exist." >&2
    59	        return 1
    60	      fi
    61	    fi
    62	  else
    63	    JAVACMD="$(
    64	      'set' +e
    65	      'unset' -f command 2>/dev/null
    66	      'command' -v java
    67	    )" || :
    68	    JAVACCMD="$(
    69	      'set' +e
    70	      'unset' -f command 2>/dev/null
    71	      'command' -v javac
    72	    )" || :
    73	
    74	    if [ ! -x "${JAVACMD-}" ] || [ ! -x "${JAVACCMD-}" ]; then
    75	      echo "The java/javac command does not exist in PATH nor is JAVA_HOME set, so mvnw cannot run." >&2
    76	      return 1
    77	    fi
    78	  fi
    79	}
    80	
    81	# hash string like Java String::hashCode
    82	hash_string() {
    83	  str="${1:-}" h=0
    84	  while [ -n "$str" ]; do
    85	    char="${str%"${str#?}"}"
    86	    h=$(((h * 31 + $(LC_CTYPE=C printf %d "'$char")) % 4294967296))
    87	    str="${str#?}"
    88	  done
    89	  printf %x\\n $h
    90	}
    91	
    92	verbose() { :; }
    93	[ "${MVNW_VERBOSE-}" != true ] || verbose() { printf %s\\n "${1-}"; }
    94	
    95	die() {
    96	  printf %s\\n "$1" >&2
    97	  exit 1
    98	}
    99	
   100	trim() {
   101	  # MWRAPPER-139:
   102	  #   Trims trailing and leading whitespace, carriage returns, tabs, and linefeeds.
   103	  #   Needed for removing poorly interpreted newline sequences when running in more
   104	  #   exotic environments such as mingw bash on Windows.
   105	  printf "%s" "${1}" | tr -d '[:space:]'
   106	}
   107	
   108	scriptDir="$(dirname "$0")"
   109	scriptName="$(basename "$0")"
   110	
   111	# parse distributionUrl and optional distributionSha256Sum, requires .mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.properties
   112	while IFS="=" read -r key value; do
   113	  case "${key-}" in
   114	  distributionUrl) distributionUrl=$(trim "${value-}") ;;
   115	  distributionSha256Sum) distributionSha256Sum=$(trim "${value-}") ;;
   116	  esac
   117	done <"$scriptDir/.mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.properties"
   118	[ -n "${distributionUrl-}" ] || die "cannot read distributionUrl property in $scriptDir/.mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.properties"
   119	
   120	case "${distributionUrl##*/}" in
   121	maven-mvnd-*bin.*)
   122	  MVN_CMD=mvnd.sh _MVNW_REPO_PATTERN=/maven/mvnd/
   123	  case "${PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE-}${PROCESSOR_ARCHITEW6432-}:$(uname -a)" in
   124	  *AMD64:CYGWIN* | *AMD64:MINGW*) distributionPlatform=windows-amd64 ;;
   125	  :Darwin*x86_64) distributionPlatform=darwin-amd64 ;;
   126	  :Darwin*arm64) distributionPlatform=darwin-aarch64 ;;
   127	  :Linux*x86_64*) distributionPlatform=linux-amd64 ;;
   128	  *)
   129	    echo "Cannot detect native platform for mvnd on $(uname)-$(uname -m), use pure java version" >&2
   130	    distributionPlatform=linux-amd64
   131	    ;;
   132	  esac
   133	  distributionUrl="${distributionUrl%-bin.*}-$distributionPlatform.zip"
   134	  ;;
   135	maven-mvnd-*) MVN_CMD=mvnd.sh _MVNW_REPO_PATTERN=/maven/mvnd/ ;;
   136	*) MVN_CMD="mvn${scriptName#mvnw}" _MVNW_REPO_PATTERN=/org/apache/maven/ ;;
   137	esac
   138	
   139	# apply MVNW_REPOURL and calculate MAVEN_HOME
   140	# maven home pattern: ~/.m2/wrapper/dists/{apache-maven-<version>,maven-mvnd-<version>-<platform>}/<hash>
   141	[ -z "${MVNW_REPOURL-}" ] || distributionUrl="$MVNW_REPOURL$_MVNW_REPO_PATTERN${distributionUrl#*"$_MVNW_REPO_PATTERN"}"
   142	distributionUrlName="${distributionUrl##*/}"
   143	distributionUrlNameMain="${distributionUrlName%.*}"
   144	distributionUrlNameMain="${distributionUrlNameMain%-bin}"
   145	MAVEN_USER_HOME="${MAVEN_USER_HOME:-${HOME}/.m2}"
   146	MAVEN_HOME="${MAVEN_USER_HOME}/wrapper/dists/${distributionUrlNameMain-}/$(hash_string "$distributionUrl")"
   147	
   148	exec_maven() {
   149	  unset MVNW_VERBOSE MVNW_USERNAME MVNW_PASSWORD MVNW_REPOURL || :
   150	  exec "$MAVEN_HOME/bin/$MVN_CMD" "$@" || die "cannot exec $MAVEN_HOME/bin/$MVN_CMD"
   151	}
   152	
   153	if [ -d "$MAVEN_HOME" ]; then
   154	  verbose "found existing MAVEN_HOME at $MAVEN_HOME"
   155	  exec_maven "$@"
   156	fi
   157	
   158	case "${distributionUrl-}" in
   159	*?-bin.zip | *?maven-mvnd-?*-?*.zip) ;;
   160	*) die "distributionUrl is not valid, must match *-bin.zip or maven-mvnd-*.zip, but found '${distributionUrl-}'" ;;
   161	esac
   162	
   163	# prepare tmp dir
   164	if TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR="$(mktemp -d)" && [ -d "$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR" ]; then
   165	  clean() { rm -rf -- "$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR"; }
   166	  trap clean HUP INT TERM EXIT
   167	else
   168	  die "cannot create temp dir"
   169	fi
   170	
   171	mkdir -p -- "${MAVEN_HOME%/*}"
   172	
   173	# Download and Install Apache Maven
   174	verbose "Couldn't find MAVEN_HOME, downloading and installing it ..."
   175	verbose "Downloading from: $distributionUrl"
   176	verbose "Downloading to: $TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR/$distributionUrlName"
   177	
   178	# select .zip or .tar.gz
   179	if ! command -v unzip >/dev/null; then
   180	  distributionUrl="${distributionUrl%.zip}.tar.gz"
   181	  distributionUrlName="${distributionUrl##*/}"
   182	fi
   183	
   184	# verbose opt
   185	__MVNW_QUIET_WGET=--quiet __MVNW_QUIET_CURL=--silent __MVNW_QUIET_UNZIP=-q __MVNW_QUIET_TAR=''
   186	[ "${MVNW_VERBOSE-}" != true ] || __MVNW_QUIET_WGET='' __MVNW_QUIET_CURL='' __MVNW_QUIET_UNZIP='' __MVNW_QUIET_TAR=v
   187	
   188	# normalize http auth
   189	case "${MVNW_PASSWORD:+has-password}" in
   190	'') MVNW_USERNAME='' MVNW_PASSWORD='' ;;
   191	has-password) [ -n "${MVNW_USERNAME-}" ] || MVNW_USERNAME='' MVNW_PASSWORD='' ;;
   192	esac
   193	
   194	if [ -z "${MVNW_USERNAME-}" ] && command -v wget >/dev/null; then
   195	  verbose "Found wget ... using wget"
   196	  wget ${__MVNW_QUIET_WGET:+"$__MVNW_QUIET_WGET"} "$distributionUrl" -O "$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR/$distributionUrlName" || die "wget: Failed to fetch $distributionUrl"
   197	elif [ -z "${MVNW_USERNAME-}" ] && command -v curl >/dev/null; then
   198	  verbose "Found curl ... using curl"
   199	  curl ${__MVNW_QUIET_CURL:+"$__MVNW_QUIET_CURL"} -f -L -o "$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR/$distributionUrlName" "$distributionUrl" || die "curl: Failed to fetch $distributionUrl"
   200	elif set_java_home; then
   201	  verbose "Falling back to use Java to download"
   202	  javaSource="$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR/Downloader.java"
   203	  targetZip="$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR/$distributionUrlName"
   204	  cat >"$javaSource" <<-END
   205		public class Downloader extends java.net.Authenticator
   206		{
   207		  protected java.net.PasswordAuthentication getPasswordAuthentication()
   208		  {
   209		    return new java.net.PasswordAuthentication( System.getenv( "MVNW_USERNAME" ), System.getenv( "MVNW_PASSWORD" ).toCharArray() );
   210		  }
   211		  public static void main( String[] args ) throws Exception
   212		  {
   213		    setDefault( new Downloader() );
   214		    java.nio.file.Files.copy( java.net.URI.create( args[0] ).toURL().openStream(), java.nio.file.Paths.get( args[1] ).toAbsolutePath().normalize() );
   215		  }
   216		}
   217		END
   218	  # For Cygwin/MinGW, switch paths to Windows format before running javac and java
   219	  verbose " - Compiling Downloader.java ..."
   220	  "$(native_path "$JAVACCMD")" "$(native_path "$javaSource")" || die "Failed to compile Downloader.java"
   221	  verbose " - Running Downloader.java ..."
   222	  "$(native_path "$JAVACMD")" -cp "$(native_path "$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR")" Downloader "$distributionUrl" "$(native_path "$targetZip")"
   223	fi
   224	
   225	# If specified, validate the SHA-256 sum of the Maven distribution zip file
   226	if [ -n "${distributionSha256Sum-}" ]; then
   227	  distributionSha256Result=false
   228	  if [ "$MVN_CMD" = mvnd.sh ]; then
   229	    echo "Checksum validation is not supported for maven-mvnd." >&2
   230	    echo "Please disable validation by removing 'distributionSha256Sum' from your maven-wrapper.properties." >&2
   231	    exit 1
   232	  elif command -v sha256sum >/dev/null; then
   233	    if echo "$distributionSha256Sum  $TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR/$distributionUrlName" | sha256sum -c - >/dev/null 2>&1; then
   234	      distributionSha256Result=true
   235	    fi
   236	  elif command -v shasum >/dev/null; then
   237	    if echo "$distributionSha256Sum  $TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR/$distributionUrlName" | shasum -a 256 -c >/dev/null 2>&1; then
   238	      distributionSha256Result=true
   239	    fi
   240	  else
   241	    echo "Checksum validation was requested but neither 'sha256sum' or 'shasum' are available." >&2
   242	    echo "Please install either command, or disable validation by removing 'distributionSha256Sum' from your maven-wrapper.properties." >&2
   243	    exit 1
   244	  fi
   245	  if [ $distributionSha256Result = false ]; then
   246	    echo "Error: Failed to validate Maven distribution SHA-256, your Maven distribution might be compromised." >&2
   247	    echo "If you updated your Maven version, you need to update the specified distributionSha256Sum property." >&2
   248	    exit 1
   249	  fi
   250	fi
   251	
   252	# unzip and move
   253	if command -v unzip >/dev/null; then
   254	  unzip ${__MVNW_QUIET_UNZIP:+"$__MVNW_QUIET_UNZIP"} "$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR/$distributionUrlName" -d "$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR" || die "failed to unzip"
   255	else
   256	  tar xzf${__MVNW_QUIET_TAR:+"$__MVNW_QUIET_TAR"} "$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR/$distributionUrlName" -C "$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR" || die "failed to untar"
   257	fi
   258	
   259	# Find the actual extracted directory name (handles snapshots where filename != directory name)
   260	actualDistributionDir=""
   261	
   262	# First try the expected directory name (for regular distributions)
   263	if [ -d "$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR/$distributionUrlNameMain" ]; then
   264	  if [ -f "$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR/$distributionUrlNameMain/bin/$MVN_CMD" ]; then
   265	    actualDistributionDir="$distributionUrlNameMain"
   266	  fi
   267	fi
   268	
   269	# If not found, search for any directory with the Maven executable (for snapshots)
   270	if [ -z "$actualDistributionDir" ]; then
   271	  # enable globbing to iterate over items
   272	  set +f
   273	  for dir in "$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR"/*; do
   274	    if [ -d "$dir" ]; then
   275	      if [ -f "$dir/bin/$MVN_CMD" ]; then
   276	        actualDistributionDir="$(basename "$dir")"
   277	        break
   278	      fi
   279	    fi
   280	  done
   281	  set -f
   282	fi
   283	
   284	if [ -z "$actualDistributionDir" ]; then
   285	  verbose "Contents of $TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR:"
   286	  verbose "$(ls -la "$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR")"
   287	  die "Could not find Maven distribution directory in extracted archive"
   288	fi
   289	
   290	verbose "Found extracted Maven distribution directory: $actualDistributionDir"
   291	printf %s\\n "$distributionUrl" >"$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR/$actualDistributionDir/mvnw.url"
   292	mv -- "$TMP_DOWNLOAD_DIR/$actualDistributionDir" "$MAVEN_HOME" || [ -d "$MAVEN_HOME" ] || die "fail to move MAVEN_HOME"
   293	
   294	clean || :
   295	exec_maven "$@"

FILE: src/main/java/com/example/messaging/auth/AuthService.java
LINES: 57

     1	package com.example.messaging.auth;
     2	
     3	import com.example.messaging.auth.dto.*;
     4	import com.example.messaging.exception.ApiException;
     5	import com.example.messaging.user.*;
     6	import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
     7	import org.springframework.security.crypto.password.PasswordEncoder;
     8	import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
     9	
    10	@Service
    11	public class AuthService {
    12	
    13	    private final UserRepository userRepository;
    14	    private final PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder;
    15	    private final JwtService jwtService;
    16	
    17	    public AuthService(
    18	            UserRepository userRepository,
    19	            PasswordEncoder passwordEncoder,
    20	            JwtService jwtService
    21	    ) {
    22	        this.userRepository = userRepository;
    23	        this.passwordEncoder = passwordEncoder;
    24	        this.jwtService = jwtService;
    25	    }
    26	
    27	    public AuthResponse register(RegisterRequest request) {
    28	        if (userRepository.existsByUsername(request.username())) {
    29	            throw new ApiException("Username already exists", HttpStatus.CONFLICT);
    30	        }
    31	
    32	        User user = User.builder()
    33	                .username(request.username())
    34	                .password(passwordEncoder.encode(request.password()))
    35	                .isActive(true)
    36	                .isDeleted(false)
    37	                .build();
    38	
    39	        userRepository.save(user);
    40	        
    41	        // Generate token for newly registered user
    42	        String token = jwtService.generateToken(user.getId().toString());
    43	        return new AuthResponse(token, user.getId().toString(), user.getUsername());
    44	    }
    45	
    46	    public AuthResponse login(LoginRequest request) {
    47	        User user = userRepository.findByUsernameAndIsDeletedFalse(request.username())
    48	                .orElseThrow(() -> new ApiException("Invalid username or password", HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED));
    49	
    50	        if (!passwordEncoder.matches(request.password(), user.getPassword())) {
    51	            throw new ApiException("Invalid username or password", HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED);
    52	        }
    53	
    54	        String token = jwtService.generateToken(user.getId().toString());
    55	        return new AuthResponse(token, user.getId().toString(), user.getUsername());
    56	    }
    57	}

     1	package com.example.messaging.auth;
     2	
     3	import com.example.messaging.user.User;
     4	import com.example.messaging.user.UserRepository;
     5	import org.springframework.lang.NonNull;
     6	import org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.*;
     7	import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
     8	
     9	@Service
    10	public class CustomUserDetailsService implements UserDetailsService {
    11	
    12	    private final UserRepository userRepository;
    13	
    14	    public CustomUserDetailsService(UserRepository userRepository) {
    15	        this.userRepository = userRepository;
    16	    }
    17	
    18	    @Override
    19	    public UserDetails loadUserByUsername(String userId)
    20	            throws UsernameNotFoundException {
    21	
    22	        User user = userRepository.findById(java.util.UUID.fromString(userId))
    23	                .orElseThrow(() -> new UsernameNotFoundException("User not found"));
    24	
    25	        return org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.User
    26	                .withUsername(user.getId().toString())
    27	                .password(user.getPassword())
    28	                .authorities("USER")
    29	                .build();
    30	    }
    31	}

FILE: src/main/java/com/example/messaging/auth/JwtAuthenticationFilter.java
LINES: 76

     1	package com.example.messaging.auth;
     2	
     3	import jakarta.servlet.FilterChain;
     4	import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
     5	import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
     6	import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
     7	import org.springframework.security.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken;
     8	import org.springframework.security.core.context.SecurityContextHolder;
     9	import org.springframework.security.core.userdetails.UserDetails;
    10	import org.springframework.security.web.authentication.WebAuthenticationDetailsSource;
    11	import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
    12	import org.springframework.util.StringUtils;
    13	import org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter;
    14	
    15	import java.io.IOException;
    16	
    17	@Component
    18	public class JwtAuthenticationFilter extends OncePerRequestFilter {
    19	
    20	    private final JwtService jwtService;
    21	    private final CustomUserDetailsService userDetailsService;
    22	
    23	    public JwtAuthenticationFilter(
    24	            JwtService jwtService,
    25	            CustomUserDetailsService userDetailsService
    26	    ) {
    27	        this.jwtService = jwtService;
    28	        this.userDetailsService = userDetailsService;
    29	    }
    30	
    31	    // ✅ THIS IS THE IMPORTANT PART
    32	    @Override
    33	    protected boolean shouldNotFilter(HttpServletRequest request) {
    34	        String path = request.getServletPath();
    35	        return path.startsWith("/api/auth");
    36	    }
    37	
    38	    @Override
    39	    protected void doFilterInternal(
    40	            HttpServletRequest request,
    41	            HttpServletResponse response,
    42	            FilterChain filterChain
    43	    ) throws ServletException, IOException {
    44	
    45	        String authHeader = request.getHeader("Authorization");
    46	
    47	        if (StringUtils.hasText(authHeader) && authHeader.startsWith("Bearer ")) {
    48	
    49	            String token = authHeader.substring(7);
    50	
    51	            if (jwtService.isTokenValid(token)) {
    52	
    53	                String userId = jwtService.extractUserId(token);
    54	
    55	                UserDetails userDetails =
    56	                        userDetailsService.loadUserByUsername(userId);
    57	
    58	                UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken authentication =
    59	                        new UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken(
    60	                                userDetails,
    61	                                null,
    62	                                userDetails.getAuthorities()
    63	                        );
    64	
    65	                authentication.setDetails(
    66	                        new WebAuthenticationDetailsSource().buildDetails(request)
    67	                );
    68	
    69	                SecurityContextHolder.getContext()
    70	                        .setAuthentication(authentication);
    71	            }
    72	        }
    73	
    74	        filterChain.doFilter(request, response);
    75	    }
    76	}

FILE: src/main/java/com/example/messaging/auth/JwtService.java
LINES: 68
================================================================================
     1	package com.example.messaging.auth;
     2	
     3	import io.jsonwebtoken.*;
     4	import io.jsonwebtoken.security.Keys;
     5	import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
     6	import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
     7	
     8	import java.security.Key;
     9	import java.util.Date;
    10	
    11	@Service
    12	public class JwtService {
    13	
    14	    private final Key key;
    15	    private final long expirationMillis;
    16	
    17	    public JwtService(
    18	            @Value("${security.jwt.secret}") String secret,
    19	            @Value("${security.jwt.access-token-expiration-minutes}") long expirationMinutes
    20	    ) {
    21	        this.key = Keys.hmacShaKeyFor(secret.getBytes());
    22	        this.expirationMillis = expirationMinutes * 60 * 1000;
    23	    }
    24	
    25	    public String generateToken(String userId) {
    26	        return Jwts.builder()
    27	                .setSubject(userId)
    28	                .setIssuedAt(new Date())
    29	                .setExpiration(new Date(System.currentTimeMillis() + expirationMillis))
    30	                .signWith(key, SignatureAlgorithm.HS256)
    31	                .compact();
    32	    }
    33	
    34	    public String extractUserId(String token) {
    35	        return parseClaims(token).getBody().getSubject();
    36	    }
    37	
    38	    public boolean isTokenValid(String token) {
    39	        try {
    40	            parseClaims(token);
    41	            return true;
    42	        } catch (JwtException | IllegalArgumentException e) {
    43	            return false;
    44	        }
    45	    }
    46	
    47	    /**
    48	     * Extract userId from token and validate it.
    49	     * Throws exception if token is invalid.
    50	     *
    51	     * @param token JWT token
    52	     * @return userId if token is valid
    53	     * @throws JwtException if token is invalid or expired
    54	     */
    55	    public String validateAndExtractUserId(String token) {
    56	        if (!isTokenValid(token)) {
    57	            throw new JwtException("Invalid or expired token");
    58	        }
    59	        return extractUserId(token);
    60	    }
    61	
    62	    private Jws<Claims> parseClaims(String token) {
    63	        return Jwts.parserBuilder()
    64	                .setSigningKey(key)
    65	                .build()
    66	                .parseClaimsJws(token);
    67	    }

FILE: src/main/java/com/example/messaging/config/CassandraConfig.java
LINES: 136
================================================================================
     1	package com.example.messaging.config;
     2	
     3	import com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core.CqlSession;
     4	import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
     5	import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
     6	import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
     7	
     8	import java.net.InetSocketAddress;
     9	
    10	@Configuration
    11	public class CassandraConfig {
    12	
    13	    @Value("${spring.cassandra.contact-points}")
    14	    private String contactPoints;
    15	
    16	    @Value("${spring.cassandra.keyspace-name}")
    17	    private String keyspaceName;
    18	
    19	    @Value("${spring.cassandra.username}")
    20	    private String username;
    21	
    22	    @Value("${spring.cassandra.password}")
    23	    private String password;
    24	
    25	    @Value("${spring.cassandra.datacenter-name}")
    26	    private String datacenterName;
    27	
    28	    /**
    29	     * Creates and configures a CqlSession for Cassandra operations.
    30	     * Initializes keyspace and message table if they don't exist.
    31	     * Gracefully handles Cassandra connection failures.
    32	     *
    33	     * @return CqlSession bean for database operations (or null if unavailable)
    34	     */
    35	    @Bean
    36	    public CqlSession cqlSession() {
    37	        try {
    38	            // First, connect WITHOUT keyspace to create it
    39	            CqlSession adminSession = CqlSession.builder()
    40	                    .addContactPoint(parseContactPoint())
    41	                    .withLocalDatacenter(datacenterName)
    42	                    .withAuthCredentials(username, password)
    43	                    .build();
    44	
    45	            // Initialize keyspace and tables
    46	            initializeKeyspaceAndTables(adminSession);
    47	
    48	            // Close admin session
    49	            adminSession.close();
    50	
    51	            // Now create the main session WITH keyspace
    52	            CqlSession session = CqlSession.builder()
    53	                    .addContactPoint(parseContactPoint())
    54	                    .withLocalDatacenter(datacenterName)
    55	                    .withAuthCredentials(username, password)
    56	                    .withKeyspace(keyspaceName)
    57	                    .build();
    58	
    59	            System.out.println("✓ CqlSession connected and ready");
    60	            return session;
    61	        } catch (Exception e) {
    62	            System.err.println("✗ Failed to connect to Cassandra: " + e.getMessage());
    63	            System.err.println("⚠ Message persistence will be unavailable");
    64	            System.err.println("⚠ Ensure Cassandra is running on " + contactPoints);
    65	            return null;  // Return null - MessageRepository will handle gracefully
    66	        }
    67	    }
    68	
    69	    /**
    70	     * Parse contact point string (format: "host:port")
    71	     */
    72	    private InetSocketAddress parseContactPoint() {
    73	        String[] parts = contactPoints.split(":");
    74	        String host = parts[0];
    75	        int port = parts.length > 1 ? Integer.parseInt(parts[1]) : 9042;
    76	        return new InetSocketAddress(host, port);
    77	    }
    78	
    79	    /**
    80	     * Initialize keyspace and message table schema.
    81	     *
    82	     * Schema Design:
    83	     * - Partition Key: conversation_id (groups messages by conversation)
    84	     * - Clustering Key: message_id (unique identifier, DESC for latest first)
    85	     *
    86	     * This allows:
    87	     * - Direct message lookup by conversation_id + message_id
    88	     * - Efficient status updates (message_id is part of primary key)
    89	     * - Natural pagination using message_id as cursor
    90	     */
    91	    private void initializeKeyspaceAndTables(CqlSession session) {
    92	        try {
    93	            // Create keyspace if not exists
    94	            String createKeyspace = String.format(
    95	                    "CREATE KEYSPACE IF NOT EXISTS %s WITH replication = " +
    96	                            "{'class': 'SimpleStrategy', 'replication_factor': 1}",
    97	                    keyspaceName
    98	            );
    99	            session.execute(createKeyspace);
   100	
   101	            // ✅ FIXED: Drop old table if exists (to fix schema)
   102	            // This will delete existing data but fixes the primary key issue
   103	            String dropOldTable = String.format(
   104	                    "DROP TABLE IF EXISTS %s.messages",
   105	                    keyspaceName
   106	            );
   107	            session.execute(dropOldTable);
   108	            System.out.println("✓ Old messages table dropped (if existed)");
   109	
   110	            // ✅ FIXED: Create new table with message_id as clustering key
   111	            // Primary key: (conversation_id, message_id)
   112	            // This allows WHERE conversation_id = ? AND message_id = ?
   113	            String createMessagesTable = String.format(
   114	                    "CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS %s.messages (" +
   115	                            "  conversation_id text, " +
   116	                            "  message_id uuid, " +
   117	                            "  created_at timestamp, " +
   118	                            "  sender_id uuid, " +
   119	                            "  receiver_id uuid, " +
   120	                            "  content text, " +
   121	                            "  status text, " +
   122	                            "  PRIMARY KEY (conversation_id, message_id)" +
   123	                            ") WITH CLUSTERING ORDER BY (message_id DESC)",
   124	                    keyspaceName
   125	            );
   126	            session.execute(createMessagesTable);
   127	
   128	            System.out.println("✓ Cassandra keyspace and tables initialized successfully");
   129	            System.out.println("✓ Schema: PRIMARY KEY (conversation_id, message_id)");
   130	        } catch (Exception e) {
   131	            System.err.println("⚠ Warning: Could not initialize Cassandra schema: " + e.getMessage());
   132	            System.err.println("⚠ This is expected if Cassandra is not running. Message persistence will be unavailable.");
   133	            // Don't throw exception - allow app to start without Cassandra
   134	        }
   135	    }
   136	}

     1	package com.example.messaging.config;
     2	
     3	import com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core.CqlSession;
     4	import org.springframework.amqp.rabbit.core.RabbitTemplate;
     5	import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
     6	import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
     7	import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.GetMapping;
     8	import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestMapping;
     9	import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestController;
    10	
    11	import java.util.HashMap;
    12	import java.util.Map;
    13	
    14	@RestController
    15	@RequestMapping("/actuator")
    16	public class HealthCheckController {
    17	
    18	    private final CqlSession cqlSession;
    19	    private final JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate;
    20	    private final RabbitTemplate rabbitTemplate;
    21	
    22	    public HealthCheckController(CqlSession cqlSession, JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate, RabbitTemplate rabbitTemplate) {
    23	        this.cqlSession = cqlSession;
    24	        this.jdbcTemplate = jdbcTemplate;
    25	        this.rabbitTemplate = rabbitTemplate;
    26	    }
    27	
    28	    @GetMapping("/health")
    29	    public ResponseEntity<Map<String, Object>> health() {
    30	        Map<String, Object> health = new HashMap<>();
    31	        health.put("status", "UP");
    32	        health.put("timestamp", System.currentTimeMillis());
    33	
    34	        try {
    35	            Integer result = jdbcTemplate.queryForObject("SELECT 1", Integer.class);
    36	            health.put("postgresql", result != null && result == 1 ? "UP" : "DOWN");
    37	            if (result == null || result != 1) {
    38	                health.put("status", "DEGRADED");
    39	            }
    40	        } catch (Exception e) {
    41	            health.put("postgresql", "DOWN");
    42	            health.put("status", "DEGRADED");
    43	        }
    44	
    45	        if (cqlSession != null) {
    46	            try {
    47	                cqlSession.execute("SELECT now() FROM system.local");
    48	                health.put("cassandra", "UP");
    49	            } catch (Exception e) {
    50	                health.put("cassandra", "DOWN");
    51	                health.put("status", "DEGRADED");
    52	            }
    53	        } else {
    54	            health.put("cassandra", "NOT_CONFIGURED");
    55	        }
    56	
    57	        try {
    58	            Boolean rabbitUp = rabbitTemplate.execute(channel -> channel != null && channel.isOpen());
    59	            health.put("rabbitmq", Boolean.TRUE.equals(rabbitUp) ? "UP" : "DOWN");
    60	            if (!Boolean.TRUE.equals(rabbitUp)) {
    61	                health.put("status", "DEGRADED");
    62	            }
    63	        } catch (Exception e) {
    64	            health.put("rabbitmq", "DOWN");
    65	            health.put("status", "DEGRADED");
    66	        }
    67	
    68	        return ResponseEntity.ok(health);
    69	    }
    70	}

     1	package com.example.messaging.config;
     2	
     3	import com.example.messaging.auth.JwtAuthenticationFilter;
     4	import org.springframework.beans.factory.annotation.Value;
     5	import org.springframework.context.annotation.Bean;
     6	import org.springframework.context.annotation.Configuration;
     7	import org.springframework.http.HttpMethod;
     8	import org.springframework.security.config.annotation.web.builders.HttpSecurity;
     9	import org.springframework.security.config.http.SessionCreationPolicy;
    10	import org.springframework.security.web.SecurityFilterChain;
    11	import org.springframework.security.web.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter;
    12	import org.springframework.web.cors.CorsConfiguration;
    13	import org.springframework.web.cors.CorsConfigurationSource;
    14	import org.springframework.web.cors.UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource;
    15	
    16	import java.util.Arrays;
    17	import java.util.List;
    18	
    19	@Configuration
    20	public class SecurityConfig {
    21	
    22	    private final JwtAuthenticationFilter jwtFilter;
    23	
    24	        @Value("${app.cors.allowed-origins:http://localhost:5000,http://127.0.0.1:5000}")
    25	        private String allowedOrigins;
    26	
    27	    public SecurityConfig(JwtAuthenticationFilter jwtFilter) {
    28	        this.jwtFilter = jwtFilter;
    29	    }
    30	
    31	    @Bean
    32	    public SecurityFilterChain filterChain(HttpSecurity http) throws Exception {
    33	        http
    34	                // ✅ Disable CSRF for stateless JWT API
    35	                .csrf(csrf -> csrf.disable())
    36	
    37	                // ✅ Enable CORS with custom config
    38	                .cors(cors -> cors.configurationSource(corsConfigurationSource()))
    39	
    40	                // ✅ Stateless session management
    41	                .sessionManagement(sm ->
    42	                        sm.sessionCreationPolicy(SessionCreationPolicy.STATELESS)
    43	                )
    44	
    45	                // ✅ Authorization rules
    46	                .authorizeHttpRequests(auth -> auth
    47	                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.POST, "/api/auth/register", "/api/auth/login").permitAll()
    48	                        .requestMatchers(HttpMethod.OPTIONS, "/**").permitAll()
    49	                        .requestMatchers("/ws-chat/**").permitAll()
    50	                        .requestMatchers("/", "/index.html", "/messenger.html", "/css/**", "/js/**", "/assets/**", "/favicon.ico").permitAll()
    51	                        .requestMatchers("/actuator/health").permitAll()
    52	                        .anyRequest().authenticated()
    53	                )
    54	
    55	                // ✅ Add JWT filter BEFORE authentication
    56	                .addFilterBefore(jwtFilter, UsernamePasswordAuthenticationFilter.class);
    57	
    58	        return http.build();
    59	    }
    60	
    61	    @Bean
    62	    public CorsConfigurationSource corsConfigurationSource() {
    63	
    64	        CorsConfiguration configuration = new CorsConfiguration();
    65	
    66	        configuration.setAllowCredentials(true);
    67	
    68	        List<String> origins = Arrays.stream(allowedOrigins.split(","))
    69	                .map(String::trim)
    70	                .filter(origin -> !origin.isEmpty())
    71	                .toList();
    72	
    73	        configuration.setAllowedOrigins(origins);
    74	
    75	        configuration.setAllowedMethods(List.of(
    76	                "GET", "POST", "PUT", "DELETE", "OPTIONS", "PATCH"
    77	        ));
    78	
    79	        configuration.setAllowedHeaders(List.of(
    80	                "Authorization",
    81	                "Content-Type",
    82	                "X-Requested-With",
    83	                "Accept",
    84	                "Origin"
    85	        ));
    86	
    87	        configuration.setExposedHeaders(List.of("Authorization"));
    88	
    89	        UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource source =
    90	                new UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource();
    91	
    92	        source.registerCorsConfiguration("/**", configuration);
    93	
    94	        return source;
    95	    }
    96	
    97	}

    27	     * Consumer listens to chat messages from RabbitMQ and persists them to Cassandra.
    28	     */

    30	    public void consume(ChatMessage message) {
    31	        try {
    32	            log.info("Received message from RabbitMQ: {}", message);
    33	
    34	            // ✅ FIXED: Log all fields to debug the issue
    35	            log.info("Message details - ID: {}, Conversation: {}, Sender: {}, Receiver: {}, Content: {}, CreatedAt: {}, Status: {}",
    36	                    message.getMessageId(),
    37	                    message.getConversationId(),
    38	                    message.getSenderId(),
    39	                    message.getReceiverId(),
    40	                    message.getContent(),
    41	                    message.getCreatedAt(),
    42	                    message.getStatus()
    43	            );
    44	
    45	            // ✅ FIXED: Manually create MessageEntity with all fields
    46	            MessageEntity messageEntity = MessageEntity.builder()
    47	                    .conversationId(message.getConversationId())
    48	                    .messageId(message.getMessageId())
    49	                    .senderId(message.getSenderId())
    50	                    .receiverId(message.getReceiverId())
    51	                    .content(message.getContent())
    52	                    .status(message.getStatus() != null ? message.getStatus() : "sent")
    53	                    .createdAt(message.getCreatedAt() != null ? message.getCreatedAt() : Instant.now())
    54	                    .build();
    55	
    56	            // Log the entity before saving
    57	            log.info("Saving entity: {}", messageEntity);
    58	
    59	            // Persist to Cassandra
    60	            messageRepository.save(messageEntity);
    61	
    62	            log.info("Message persisted to Cassandra: {}", message.getMessageId());
    63	        } catch (Exception e) {
    64	            log.error("Error persisting message: {}", e.getMessage(), e);
    65	        }
    66	    }

    15	    Optional<Conversation> findByUserAIdAndUserBId(UUID userAId, UUID userBId);
    16	
    17	    @Query("SELECT c FROM Conversation c WHERE (c.userAId = :userId OR c.userBId = :userId) AND c.isDeleted = false ORDER BY c.updatedAt DESC")
    18	    List<Conversation> findByUserIdAndIsDeletedFalse(@Param("userId") UUID userId);

FILE: src/main/java/com/example/messaging/conversation/controller/ConversationController.java

     1	package com.example.messaging.conversation.controller;
     2	
     3	import com.example.messaging.conversation.Conversation;
     4	import com.example.messaging.conversation.ConversationRepository;
     5	import com.example.messaging.message.cassandra.entity.MessageEntity;
     6	import com.example.messaging.message.cassandra.repository.MessageRepository;
     7	import com.example.messaging.user.User;
     8	import com.example.messaging.user.UserRepository;
     9	import org.slf4j.Logger;
    10	import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
    11	import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
    12	import org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize;
    13	import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
    14	
    15	import java.security.Principal;
    16	import java.util.*;
    17	import java.util.stream.StreamSupport;
    18	import java.util.stream.Collectors;
    19	
    20	@RestController
    21	@RequestMapping("/api/conversations")
    22	public class ConversationController {
    23	
    24	    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ConversationController.class);
    25	
    26	    private final ConversationRepository conversationRepository;
    27	    private final UserRepository userRepository;
    28	    private final MessageRepository messageRepository;
    29	
    30	    public ConversationController(
    31	            ConversationRepository conversationRepository,
    32	            UserRepository userRepository,
    33	            MessageRepository messageRepository) {
    34	        this.conversationRepository = conversationRepository;
    35	        this.userRepository = userRepository;
    36	        this.messageRepository = messageRepository;
    37	    }
    38	
    39	    /**
    40	     * Get all conversations for the current user with other user info and last message.
    41	     */
    42	    @GetMapping
    43	    @PreAuthorize("isAuthenticated()")
    44	    public ResponseEntity<List<Map<String, Object>>> getConversations(Principal principal) {
    45	        UUID userId = UUID.fromString(principal.getName());
    46	        List<Conversation> conversations = conversationRepository.findByUserIdAndIsDeletedFalse(userId);
    47	
    48	        Set<UUID> otherUserIds = conversations.stream()
    49	            .map(conv -> conv.getUserAId().equals(userId) ? conv.getUserBId() : conv.getUserAId())
    50	            .collect(Collectors.toSet());
    51	
    52	        Map<UUID, User> userMap = StreamSupport.stream(userRepository.findAllById(otherUserIds).spliterator(), false)
    53	            .collect(Collectors.toMap(User::getId, user -> user));
    54	
    55	        List<Map<String, Object>> response = conversations.stream().map(conv -> {
    56	            UUID otherId = conv.getUserAId().equals(userId) ? conv.getUserBId() : conv.getUserAId();
    57	            User otherUser = userMap.get(otherId);
    58	
    59	            Map<String, Object> item = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    60	            item.put("conversationId", conv.getConversationId());
    61	            item.put("otherUser", Map.of(
    62	                    "id", otherUser != null ? otherUser.getId().toString() : otherId.toString(),
    63	                    "username", otherUser != null ? otherUser.getUsername() : "Unknown"
    64	            ));
    65	
    66	            // Get last message for preview
    67	            try {
    68	                List<MessageEntity> lastMessages = messageRepository.findByConversationId(conv.getConversationId(), 1);
    69	                if (!lastMessages.isEmpty()) {
    70	                    MessageEntity last = lastMessages.get(0);
    71	                    Map<String, Object> lastMsg = new LinkedHashMap<>();
    72	                    lastMsg.put("content", last.getContent());
    73	                    lastMsg.put("createdAt", last.getCreatedAt().toString());
    74	                    lastMsg.put("senderId", last.getSenderId().toString());
    75	                    lastMsg.put("status", last.getStatus());
    76	                    lastMsg.put("messageId", last.getMessageId().toString());
    77	                    item.put("lastMessage", lastMsg);
    78	                }
    79	            } catch (Exception e) {
    80	                log.warn("Failed to fetch last message for conversation {}: {}", conv.getConversationId(), e.getMessage());
    81	            }
    82	
    83	            item.put("createdAt", conv.getCreatedAt() != null ? conv.getCreatedAt().toString() : null);
    84	            return item;
    85	        }).collect(Collectors.toList());
    86	
    87	        return ResponseEntity.ok(response);
    88	    }
    89	}

FILE: src/main/java/com/example/messaging/conversation/service/ConversationService.java
LINES: 112
================================================================================
     1	package com.example.messaging.conversation.service;
     2	
     3	import com.example.messaging.conversation.Conversation;
     4	import com.example.messaging.conversation.ConversationRepository;
     5	import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
     6	import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
     7	
     8	import java.security.MessageDigest;
     9	import java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException;
    10	import java.util.UUID;
    11	
    12	@Service
    13	@Transactional
    14	public class ConversationService {
    15	
    16	    private final ConversationRepository conversationRepository;
    17	
    18	    public ConversationService(ConversationRepository conversationRepository) {
    19	        this.conversationRepository = conversationRepository;
    20	    }
    21	
    22	    /**
    23	     * Find or create a conversation between two users.
    24	     * Uses deterministic conversationId based on sorted user IDs to ensure uniqueness.
    25	     *
    26	     * @param userId1 First user ID
    27	     * @param userId2 Second user ID
    28	     * @return Existing or newly created conversation
    29	     */
    30	    public Conversation findOrCreateConversation(UUID userId1, UUID userId2) {
    31	        if (userId1.equals(userId2)) {
    32	            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cannot create conversation with same user");
    33	        }
    34	
    35	        // Sort IDs to ensure consistency (A, B) = (B, A)
    36	        UUID userAId = userId1.compareTo(userId2) < 0 ? userId1 : userId2;
    37	        UUID userBId = userId1.compareTo(userId2) < 0 ? userId2 : userId1;
    38	
    39	        // Try to find existing conversation
    40	        return conversationRepository.findByUserAIdAndUserBId(userAId, userBId)
    41	                .orElseGet(() -> createNewConversation(userAId, userBId));
    42	    }
    43	
    44	    /**
    45	     * Create a new conversation with a deterministic conversationId.
    46	     * ConversationId is derived from sorted user pair hash.
    47	     *
    48	     * @param userAId First user ID (must be sorted before calling this method)
    49	     * @param userBId Second user ID (must be sorted before calling this method)
    50	     * @return Newly created conversation
    51	     */
    52	    private Conversation createNewConversation(UUID userAId, UUID userBId) {
    53	        String conversationId = generateDeterministicId(userAId, userBId);
    54	
    55	        Conversation conversation = Conversation.builder()
    56	                .conversationId(conversationId)
    57	                .userAId(userAId)
    58	                .userBId(userBId)
    59	                .isActive(true)
    60	                .build();
    61	
    62	        return conversationRepository.save(conversation);
    63	    }
    64	
    65	    /**
    66	     * Generate a deterministic conversationId from two sorted UUIDs.
    67	     * Uses SHA-256 hash of concatenated UUID strings.
    68	     *
    69	     * @param userAId First user ID (sorted)
    70	     * @param userBId Second user ID (sorted)
    71	     * @return Deterministic conversationId (hex string, length 64)
    72	     */
    73	    private String generateDeterministicId(UUID userAId, UUID userBId) {
    74	        String combined = userAId.toString() + userBId.toString();
    75	        try {
    76	            MessageDigest digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256");
    77	            byte[] hash = digest.digest(combined.getBytes());
    78	            return bytesToHex(hash);
    79	        } catch (NoSuchAlgorithmException e) {
    80	            throw new RuntimeException("SHA-256 algorithm not available", e);
    81	        }
    82	    }
    83	
    84	    /**
    85	     * Convert byte array to hex string.
    86	     *
    87	     * @param bytes Byte array to convert
    88	     * @return Hex string representation
    89	     */
    90	    private String bytesToHex(byte[] bytes) {
    91	        StringBuilder hexString = new StringBuilder();
    92	        for (byte b : bytes) {
    93	            String hex = Integer.toHexString(0xff & b);
    94	            if (hex.length() == 1) {
    95	                hexString.append('0');
    96	            }
    97	            hexString.append(hex);
    98	        }
    99	        return hexString.toString();
   100	    }
   101	
   102	    /**
   103	     * Get conversation by ID if active.
   104	     *
   105	     * @param conversationId Conversation ID
   106	     * @return Conversation if found and active
   107	     */
   108	    public Conversation getConversation(String conversationId) {
   109	        return conversationRepository.findByConversationIdAndIsDeletedFalse(conversationId)
   110	                .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("Conversation not found: " + conversationId));
   111	    }
   112	}

     1	package com.example.messaging.exception;
     2	
     3	import io.jsonwebtoken.JwtException;
     4	import jakarta.validation.ConstraintViolationException;
     5	import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
     6	import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
     7	import org.springframework.security.authentication.BadCredentialsException;
     8	import org.springframework.validation.FieldError;
     9	import org.springframework.web.bind.MethodArgumentNotValidException;
    10	import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ExceptionHandler;
    11	import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestControllerAdvice;
    12	
    13	import java.time.Instant;
    14	import java.util.HashMap;
    15	import java.util.Map;
    16	import java.util.stream.Collectors;
    17	
    18	@RestControllerAdvice
    19	public class GlobalExceptionHandler {
    20	
    21	    @ExceptionHandler(ApiException.class)
    22	    public ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> handleApiException(ApiException e) {
    23	        ErrorResponse error = new ErrorResponse(e.getMessage(), e.getStatus().value(), Instant.now());
    24	        return ResponseEntity.status(e.getStatus()).body(error);
    25	    }
    26	
    27	    @ExceptionHandler(BadCredentialsException.class)
    28	    public ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> handleBadCredentials(BadCredentialsException e) {
    29	        ErrorResponse error = new ErrorResponse("Invalid username or password", HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED.value(), Instant.now());
    30	        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED).body(error);
    31	    }
    32	
    33	    @ExceptionHandler(JwtException.class)
    34	    public ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> handleJwtException(JwtException e) {
    35	        ErrorResponse error = new ErrorResponse("Invalid or expired token", HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED.value(), Instant.now());
    36	        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED).body(error);
    37	    }
    38	
    39	    @ExceptionHandler(MethodArgumentNotValidException.class)
    40	    public ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> handleValidationException(MethodArgumentNotValidException e) {
    41	        Map<String, String> errors = new HashMap<>();
    42	        e.getBindingResult().getAllErrors().forEach(error -> {
    43	            if (error instanceof FieldError fieldError) {
    44	                errors.put(fieldError.getField(), error.getDefaultMessage());
    45	            } else {
    46	                errors.put(error.getObjectName(), error.getDefaultMessage());
    47	            }
    48	        });
    49	
    50	        ErrorResponse error = new ErrorResponse(
    51	                "Validation failed: " + errors,
    52	                HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST.value(),
    53	                Instant.now()
    54	        );
    55	        return ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(error);
    56	    }
    57	
    58	    @ExceptionHandler(ConstraintViolationException.class)
    59	    public ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> handleConstraintViolation(ConstraintViolationException e) {
    60	        String message = e.getConstraintViolations().stream()
    61	                .map(violation -> violation.getPropertyPath() + ": " + violation.getMessage())
    62	                .collect(Collectors.joining(", "));
    63	
    64	        ErrorResponse error = new ErrorResponse(
    65	                "Validation failed: " + message,
    66	                HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST.value(),
    67	                Instant.now()
    68	        );
    69	        return ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(error);
    70	    }
    71	
    72	    @ExceptionHandler(Exception.class)
    73	    public ResponseEntity<ErrorResponse> handleGenericException(Exception e) {
    74	        ErrorResponse error = new ErrorResponse(
    75	                "An unexpected error occurred",
    76	                HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR.value(),
    77	                Instant.now()
    78	        );
    79	        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR).body(error);
    80	    }
    81	}

     1	package com.example.messaging.groupchat.service;
     2	
     3	import com.example.messaging.groupchat.dto.*;
     4	import com.example.messaging.groupchat.entity.GroupConversation;
     5	import com.example.messaging.groupchat.entity.GroupMember;
     6	import com.example.messaging.groupchat.entity.GroupMessage;
     7	import com.example.messaging.groupchat.repository.*;
     8	import com.example.messaging.exception.ApiException;
     9	import com.example.messaging.user.User;
    10	import com.example.messaging.user.UserRepository;
    11	import lombok.RequiredArgsConstructor;
    12	import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
    13	import org.springframework.data.domain.Page;
    14	import org.springframework.data.domain.PageRequest;
    15	import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
    16	import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
    17	
    18	import java.time.Instant;
    19	import java.util.ArrayList;
    20	import java.util.List;
    21	import java.util.UUID;
    22	import java.util.stream.Collectors;
    23	
    24	@Service
    25	@RequiredArgsConstructor
    26	public class GroupMessageService {
    27	
    28	    private final GroupMessageRepository groupMessageRepository;
    29	    private final GroupMemberRepository groupMemberRepository;
    30	    private final GroupConversationRepository groupConversationRepository;
    31	    private final UserRepository userRepository;
    32	
    33	    public GroupMessageResponse saveMessage(
    34	            GroupMessageRequest request,
    35	            UUID senderId
    36	    ) {
    37	        if (!groupMemberRepository.existsByGroupIdAndUserId(request.getGroupId(), senderId)) {
    38	            throw new ApiException("User not in group", HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN);
    39	        }
    40	
    41	        GroupMessage message = new GroupMessage();
    42	        message.setGroupId(request.getGroupId());
    43	        message.setSenderId(senderId);
    44	        message.setContent(request.getContent());
    45	        message.setCreatedAt(Instant.now());
    46	
    47	        message = groupMessageRepository.save(message);
    48	
    49	        return toMessageResponse(message);
    50	    }
    51	
    52	    @Transactional
    53	    public GroupResponse createGroup(CreateGroupRequest request, UUID creatorId) {
    54	        GroupConversation group = GroupConversation.builder()
    55	                .name(request.getName())
    56	                .createdBy(creatorId)
    57	                .createdAt(Instant.now())
    58	                .build();
    59	
    60	        group = groupConversationRepository.save(group);
    61	
    62	        // Add creator as member
    63	        GroupMember creatorMember = GroupMember.builder()
    64	                .groupId(group.getId())
    65	                .userId(creatorId)
    66	                .build();
    67	        groupMemberRepository.save(creatorMember);
    68	
    69	        // Add other members
    70	        if (request.getMemberIds() != null) {
    71	            for (UUID memberId : request.getMemberIds()) {
    72	                if (!memberId.equals(creatorId)) {
    73	                    GroupMember member = GroupMember.builder()
    74	                            .groupId(group.getId())
    75	                            .userId(memberId)
    76	                            .build();
    77	                    groupMemberRepository.save(member);
    78	                }
    79	            }
    80	        }
    81	
    82	        return toGroupResponse(group);
    83	    }
    84	
    85	    public List<GroupResponse> getUserGroups(UUID userId) {
    86	        List<GroupMember> memberships = groupMemberRepository.findByUserId(userId);
    87	        List<GroupResponse> groups = new ArrayList<>();
    88	
    89	        for (GroupMember membership : memberships) {
    90	            groupConversationRepository.findById(membership.getGroupId())
    91	                    .ifPresent(group -> groups.add(toGroupResponse(group)));
    92	        }
    93	
    94	        return groups;
    95	    }
    96	
    97	    public GroupResponse getGroup(UUID groupId, UUID userId) {
    98	        if (!groupMemberRepository.existsByGroupIdAndUserId(groupId, userId)) {
    99	            throw new ApiException("User not in group", HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN);
   100	        }
   101	
   102	        GroupConversation group = groupConversationRepository.findById(groupId)
   103	                .orElseThrow(() -> new ApiException("Group not found", HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND));
   104	
   105	        return toGroupResponse(group);
   106	    }
   107	
   108	    public List<GroupMessageResponse> getMessages(UUID groupId, UUID userId, int page, int size) {
   109	        if (!groupMemberRepository.existsByGroupIdAndUserId(groupId, userId)) {
   110	            throw new ApiException("User not in group", HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN);
   111	        }
   112	
   113	        Page<GroupMessage> messages = groupMessageRepository
   114	                .findByGroupIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc(groupId, PageRequest.of(page, size));
   115	
   116	        return messages.getContent().stream()
   117	                .map(this::toMessageResponse)
   118	                .collect(Collectors.toList());
   119	    }
   120	
   121	    @Transactional
   122	    public void addMember(UUID groupId, UUID userId, UUID requesterId) {
   123	        if (!groupMemberRepository.existsByGroupIdAndUserId(groupId, requesterId)) {
   124	            throw new ApiException("You are not in this group", HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN);
   125	        }
   126	
   127	        if (groupMemberRepository.existsByGroupIdAndUserId(groupId, userId)) {
   128	            throw new ApiException("User is already a member", HttpStatus.CONFLICT);
   129	        }
   130	
   131	        GroupMember member = GroupMember.builder()
   132	                .groupId(groupId)
   133	                .userId(userId)
   134	                .build();
   135	        groupMemberRepository.save(member);
   136	    }
   137	
   138	    @Transactional
   139	    public void removeMember(UUID groupId, UUID userId, UUID requesterId) {
   140	        GroupConversation group = groupConversationRepository.findById(groupId)
   141	                .orElseThrow(() -> new ApiException("Group not found", HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND));
   142	
   143	        // Only creator can remove members (or user can remove themselves)
   144	        if (!group.getCreatedBy().equals(requesterId) && !userId.equals(requesterId)) {
   145	            throw new ApiException("Only group creator can remove members", HttpStatus.FORBIDDEN);
   146	        }
   147	
   148	        groupMemberRepository.deleteByGroupIdAndUserId(groupId, userId);
   149	    }
   150	
   151	    public List<UUID> getGroupMemberIds(UUID groupId) {
   152	        return groupMemberRepository.findByGroupId(groupId).stream()
   153	                .map(GroupMember::getUserId)
   154	                .collect(Collectors.toList());
   155	    }
   156	
   157	    private GroupMessageResponse toMessageResponse(GroupMessage message) {
   158	        User sender = userRepository.findById(message.getSenderId()).orElse(null);
   159	        
   160	        return GroupMessageResponse.builder()
   161	                .messageId(message.getId())
   162	                .groupId(message.getGroupId())
   163	                .senderId(message.getSenderId())
   164	                .senderUsername(sender != null ? sender.getUsername() : "Unknown")
   165	                .content(message.getContent())
   166	                .createdAt(message.getCreatedAt())
   167	                .build();
   168	    }
   169	
   170	    private GroupResponse toGroupResponse(GroupConversation group) {
   171	        List<GroupMember> members = groupMemberRepository.findByGroupId(group.getId());
   172	        List<GroupResponse.GroupMemberInfo> memberInfos = new ArrayList<>();
   173	
   174	        for (GroupMember member : members) {
   175	            userRepository.findById(member.getUserId()).ifPresent(user ->
   176	                    memberInfos.add(GroupResponse.GroupMemberInfo.builder()
   177	                            .userId(user.getId())
   178	                            .username(user.getUsername())
   179	                            .build())
   180	            );
   181	        }
   182	
   183	        // Get last message
   184	        GroupMessageResponse lastMessage = groupMessageRepository
   185	                .findFirstByGroupIdOrderByCreatedAtDesc(group.getId())
   186	                .map(this::toMessageResponse)
   187	                .orElse(null);
   188	
   189	        return GroupResponse.builder()
   190	                .id(group.getId())
   191	                .name(group.getName())
   192	                .createdBy(group.getCreatedBy())
   193	                .createdAt(group.getCreatedAt())
   194	                .members(memberInfos)
   195	                .lastMessage(lastMessage)
   196	                .build();
   197	    }
   198	}

    48	                .content(content)
    49	                .status("sent")

     1	package com.example.messaging.message.cassandra.repository;
     2	
     3	import com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core.CqlSession;
     4	import com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core.cql.ResultSet;
     5	import com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core.cql.Row;
     6	import com.example.messaging.message.cassandra.entity.MessageEntity;
     7	import org.slf4j.Logger;
     8	import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
     9	import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;
    10	
    11	import java.time.Instant;
    12	import java.util.ArrayList;
    13	import java.util.List;
    14	import java.util.Optional;
    15	import java.util.UUID;
    16	
    17	/**
    18	 * Repository for Cassandra message operations.
    19	 * Handles persistence and retrieval of messages from Cassandra.
    20	 */
    21	@Repository
    22	public class MessageRepository {
    23	
    24	    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(MessageRepository.class);
    25	
    26	    private final CqlSession cqlSession;
    27	    private static final String TABLE_NAME = "messages";
    28	    private static final String KEYSPACE = "messaging";
    29	
    30	    public MessageRepository(CqlSession cqlSession) {
    31	        this.cqlSession = cqlSession;
    32	    }
    33	
    34	    /**
    35	     * Save a message to Cassandra.
    36	     * Gracefully handles cases where Cassandra is unavailable.
    37	     *
    38	     * @param message MessageEntity to save
    39	     * @return Saved message (or null if Cassandra unavailable)
    40	     */
    41	    public MessageEntity save(MessageEntity message) {
    42	        if (cqlSession == null) {
    43	            log.warn("Cassandra unavailable - message not persisted: {}", message.getMessageId());
    44	            return message;
    45	        }
    46	
    47	        try {
    48	            // Ensure createdAt is not null
    49	            Instant createdAt = message.getCreatedAt();
    50	            if (createdAt == null) {
    51	                createdAt = Instant.now();
    52	                message.setCreatedAt(createdAt);
    53	                log.warn("Message {} had null createdAt, setting to now", message.getMessageId());
    54	            }
    55	
    56	            // Ensure status is not null
    57	            String status = message.getStatus();
    58	            if (status == null) {
    59	                status = "sent";
    60	                message.setStatus(status);
    61	            }
    62	
    63	            String query = String.format(
    64	                    "INSERT INTO %s.%s " +
    65	                            "(conversation_id, message_id, created_at, sender_id, receiver_id, content, status) " +
    66	                            "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) " +
    67	                            "IF NOT EXISTS",
    68	                    KEYSPACE, TABLE_NAME
    69	            );
    70	
    71	            cqlSession.execute(
    72	                    cqlSession.prepare(query).bind(
    73	                            message.getConversationId(),
    74	                            message.getMessageId(),
    75	                            createdAt,
    76	                            message.getSenderId(),
    77	                            message.getReceiverId(),
    78	                            message.getContent(),
    79	                            status
    80	                    )
    81	            );
    82	
    83	            log.debug("Message saved: {}", message.getMessageId());
    84	            return message;
    85	        } catch (Exception e) {
    86	            log.error("Error saving message to Cassandra: {}", e.getMessage(), e);
    87	            return message;
    88	        }
    89	    }
    90	
    91	    /**
    92	     * Find message by conversation ID and message ID.
    93	     *
    94	     * @param conversationId Conversation ID
    95	     * @param messageId Message ID
    96	     * @return Optional containing message if found
    97	     */
    98	    public Optional<MessageEntity> findByIdInConversation(String conversationId, UUID messageId) {
    99	        if (cqlSession == null) {
   100	            return Optional.empty();
   101	        }
   102	
   103	        try {
   104	            String query = String.format(
   105	                    "SELECT * FROM %s.%s " +
   106	                            "WHERE conversation_id = ? AND message_id = ?",
   107	                    KEYSPACE, TABLE_NAME
   108	            );
   109	
   110	            ResultSet resultSet = cqlSession.execute(
   111	                    cqlSession.prepare(query).bind(conversationId, messageId)
   112	            );
   113	
   114	            Row row = resultSet.one();
   115	            return row != null ? Optional.of(mapRowToEntity(row)) : Optional.empty();
   116	        } catch (Exception e) {
   117	            log.error("Error finding message: {}", e.getMessage());
   118	            return Optional.empty();
   119	        }
   120	    }
   121	
   122	    /**
   123	     * Get all messages in a conversation (newest first).
   124	     * Limits to specified number of messages.
   125	     *
   126	     * @param conversationId Conversation ID
   127	     * @param limit Maximum number of messages to retrieve
   128	     * @return List of messages
   129	     */
   130	    public List<MessageEntity> findByConversationId(String conversationId, int limit) {
   131	        if (cqlSession == null) {
   132	            log.warn("Cassandra unavailable - returning empty list");
   133	            return new ArrayList<>();
   134	        }
   135	
   136	        try {
   137	            String query = String.format(
   138	                    "SELECT * FROM %s.%s " +
   139	                            "WHERE conversation_id = ? " +
   140	                            "LIMIT ?",
   141	                    KEYSPACE, TABLE_NAME
   142	            );
   143	
   144	            ResultSet resultSet = cqlSession.execute(
   145	                    cqlSession.prepare(query).bind(conversationId, limit)
   146	            );
   147	
   148	            List<MessageEntity> messages = new ArrayList<>();
   149	            for (Row row : resultSet) {
   150	                messages.add(mapRowToEntity(row));
   151	            }
   152	            return messages;
   153	        } catch (Exception e) {
   154	            log.error("Error fetching messages: {}", e.getMessage());
   155	            return new ArrayList<>();
   156	        }
   157	    }
   158	
   159	    /**
   160	     * Get messages in conversation after a specific message ID (for pagination).
   161	     *
   162	     * @param conversationId Conversation ID
   163	     * @param messageId Cursor message ID (exclusive)
   164	     * @param limit Maximum number of messages to retrieve
   165	     * @return List of messages after cursor
   166	     */
   167	    public List<MessageEntity> findByConversationIdAfterCursor(String conversationId, UUID messageId, int limit) {
   168	        if (cqlSession == null) {
   169	            log.warn("Cassandra unavailable - returning empty list");
   170	            return new ArrayList<>();
   171	        }
   172	
   173	        try {
   174	            String query = String.format(
   175	                    "SELECT * FROM %s.%s " +
   176	                            "WHERE conversation_id = ? AND message_id < ? " +
   177	                            "LIMIT ?",
   178	                    KEYSPACE, TABLE_NAME
   179	            );
   180	
   181	            ResultSet resultSet = cqlSession.execute(
   182	                    cqlSession.prepare(query).bind(conversationId, messageId, limit)
   183	            );
   184	
   185	            List<MessageEntity> messages = new ArrayList<>();
   186	            for (Row row : resultSet) {
   187	                messages.add(mapRowToEntity(row));
   188	            }
   189	            return messages;
   190	        } catch (Exception e) {
   191	            log.error("Error fetching messages after cursor: {}", e.getMessage());
   192	            return new ArrayList<>();
   193	        }
   194	    }
   195	
   196	    /**
   197	     * Update message status (sent/delivered/seen).
   198	     *
   199	     * @param conversationId Conversation ID
   200	     * @param messageId Message ID (part of primary key)
   201	     * @param status New status
   202	     */
   203	    public void updateStatus(String conversationId, UUID messageId, String status) {
   204	        if (cqlSession == null) {
   205	            log.warn("Cassandra unavailable - status not updated for message: {}", messageId);
   206	            return;
   207	        }
   208	
   209	        try {
   210	            String query = String.format(
   211	                    "UPDATE %s.%s " +
   212	                            "SET status = ? " +
   213	                            "WHERE conversation_id = ? AND message_id = ?",
   214	                    KEYSPACE, TABLE_NAME
   215	            );
   216	
   217	            cqlSession.execute(
   218	                    cqlSession.prepare(query).bind(status, conversationId, messageId)
   219	            );
   220	
   221	            log.debug("Message status updated: {} -> {}", messageId, status);
   222	        } catch (Exception e) {
   223	            log.error("Error updating message status: {}", e.getMessage());
   224	        }
   225	    }
   226	
   227	    /**
   228	     * Map Cassandra Row to MessageEntity.
   229	     */
   230	    private MessageEntity mapRowToEntity(Row row) {
   231	        MessageEntity.MessageEntityBuilder builder = MessageEntity.builder();
   232	
   233	        try {
   234	            builder.conversationId(row.getString("conversation_id"));
   235	        } catch (Exception e) {
   236	            log.warn("conversation_id is null");
   237	            builder.conversationId("");
   238	        }
   239	
   240	        try {
   241	            builder.messageId(row.getUuid("message_id"));
   242	        } catch (Exception e) {
   243	            log.warn("message_id is null");
   244	            builder.messageId(UUID.randomUUID());
   245	        }
   246	
   247	        try {
   248	            builder.createdAt(row.getInstant("created_at"));
   249	        } catch (Exception e) {
   250	            log.warn("created_at is null");
   251	            builder.createdAt(Instant.now());
   252	        }
   253	
   254	        try {
   255	            builder.senderId(row.getUuid("sender_id"));
   256	        } catch (Exception e) {
   257	            log.warn("sender_id is null");
   258	            builder.senderId(null);
   259	        }
   260	
   261	        try {
   262	            builder.receiverId(row.getUuid("receiver_id"));
   263	        } catch (Exception e) {
   264	            log.warn("receiver_id is null");
   265	            builder.receiverId(null);
   266	        }
   267	
   268	        try {
   269	            builder.content(row.getString("content"));
   270	        } catch (Exception e) {
   271	            log.warn("content is null");
   272	            builder.content("");
   273	        }
   274	
   275	        try {
   276	            builder.status(row.getString("status"));
   277	        } catch (Exception e) {
   278	            log.warn("status is null");
   279	            builder.status("sent");
   280	        }
   281	
   282	        return builder.build();
   283	    }
   284	}
