     1	package com.example.messaging.message.controller;
     2	
     3	import com.example.messaging.message.cassandra.entity.MessageEntity;
     4	import com.example.messaging.message.cassandra.repository.MessageRepository;
     5	import com.example.messaging.message.dto.MessageResponse;
     6	import com.example.messaging.message.dto.PaginationResponse;
     7	import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
     8	import org.springframework.security.access.prepost.PreAuthorize;
     9	import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
    10	
    11	import java.time.Instant;
    12	import java.util.List;
    13	import java.util.UUID;
    14	import java.util.stream.Collectors;
    15	
    16	/**
    17	 * REST API for message operations including pagination.
    18	 * Provides cursor-based pagination for efficient message history scrolling.
    19	 */
    20	@RestController
    21	@RequestMapping("/api/messages")
    22	public class MessageController {
    23	
    24	    private final MessageRepository messageRepository;
    25	    private static final int DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE = 50;
    26	    private static final int MAX_PAGE_SIZE = 200;
    27	
    28	    public MessageController(MessageRepository messageRepository) {
    29	        this.messageRepository = messageRepository;
    30	    }
    31	
    32	    /**
    33	     * Get messages from a conversation with cursor-based pagination.
    34	     *
    35	     * @param conversationId Conversation ID
    36	     * @param cursor Optional cursor for pagination (message ID of last message in previous page)
    37	     * @param limit Number of messages to retrieve (default 50, max 200)
    38	     * @return Paginated message response with nextCursor for loading more
    39	     */
    40	    @GetMapping("/conversations/{conversationId}")
    41	    @PreAuthorize("isAuthenticated()")
    42	    public ResponseEntity<PaginationResponse> getConversationMessages(
    43	            @PathVariable String conversationId,
    44	            @RequestParam(required = false) UUID cursor,  // ✅ Changed from Instant to UUID
    45	            @RequestParam(defaultValue = "50") int limit) {
    46	
    47	        // Validate limit
    48	        if (limit <= 0 || limit > MAX_PAGE_SIZE) {
    49	            limit = DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE;
    50	        }
    51	
    52	        // Fetch messages (limit + 1 to detect if there are more)
    53	        List<MessageEntity> messages;
    54	        if (cursor == null) {
    55	            messages = messageRepository.findByConversationId(conversationId, limit + 1);
    56	        } else {
    57	            // ✅ FIXED: Pass UUID cursor instead of Instant
    58	            messages = messageRepository.findByConversationIdAfterCursor(conversationId, cursor, limit + 1);
    59	        }
    60	
    61	        // Determine if there are more messages
    62	        boolean hasMore = messages.size() > limit;
    63	        if (hasMore) {
    64	            messages = messages.subList(0, limit);
    65	        }
    66	
    67	        // Convert to response DTOs
    68	        List<MessageResponse> responses = messages.stream()
    69	                .map(this::mapToResponse)
    70	                .collect(Collectors.toList());
    71	
    72	        // Calculate nextCursor (message ID of last message in this page)
    73	        UUID nextCursor = null;  // ✅ Changed from Instant to UUID
    74	        if (hasMore && !messages.isEmpty()) {
    75	            nextCursor = messages.get(messages.size() - 1).getMessageId();  // ✅ Changed to getMessageId()
    76	        }
    77	
    78	        return ResponseEntity.ok(new PaginationResponse(responses, nextCursor, hasMore));
    79	    }
    80	
    81	    /**
    82	     * Get a single message by ID.
    83	     *
    84	     * @param conversationId Conversation ID
    85	     * @param messageId Message ID
    86	     * @return Message if found
    87	     */
    88	    @GetMapping("/conversations/{conversationId}/messages/{messageId}")
    89	    @PreAuthorize("isAuthenticated()")
    90	    public ResponseEntity<MessageResponse> getMessage(
    91	            @PathVariable String conversationId,
    92	            @PathVariable UUID messageId) {
    93	
    94	        return messageRepository.findByIdInConversation(conversationId, messageId)
    95	                .map(msg -> ResponseEntity.ok(mapToResponse(msg)))
    96	                .orElseGet(() -> ResponseEntity.notFound().build());
    97	    }
    98	
    99	    /**
   100	     * Get conversation statistics (message count, last message time).
   101	     *
   102	     * @param conversationId Conversation ID
   103	     * @return Conversation stats
   104	     */
   105	    @GetMapping("/conversations/{conversationId}/stats")
   106	    @PreAuthorize("isAuthenticated()")
   107	    public ResponseEntity<?> getConversationStats(
   108	            @PathVariable String conversationId) {
   109	
   110	        try {
   111	            List<MessageEntity> messages = messageRepository.findByConversationId(conversationId, 1);
   112	
   113	            if (messages.isEmpty()) {
   114	                return ResponseEntity.ok(new Object() {
   115	                    public int messageCount = 0;
   116	                    public Object lastMessageTime = null;
   117	                });
   118	            }
   119	
   120	            MessageEntity lastMessage = messages.get(0);
   121	            return ResponseEntity.ok(new Object() {
   122	                public int messageCount = messages.size();
   123	                public Instant lastMessageTime = lastMessage.getCreatedAt();
   124	            });
   125	        } catch (Exception e) {
   126	            return ResponseEntity.status(500).body("Unable to fetch stats: " + e.getMessage());
   127	        }
   128	    }
   129	
   130	    /**
   131	     * Convert MessageEntity to MessageResponse DTO.
   132	     */
   133	    private MessageResponse mapToResponse(MessageEntity entity) {
   134	        return new MessageResponse(
   135	                entity.getMessageId(),
   136	                entity.getConversationId(),
   137	                entity.getSenderId(),
   138	                entity.getReceiverId(),
   139	                entity.getContent(),
   140	                entity.getStatus(),
   141	                entity.getCreatedAt()
   142	        );
   143	    }
   144	}

    28	        return userRepository.findById(userId)

    37	     * Search users by username (partial match, case-insensitive).
    38	     */
    39	    @GetMapping("/search")
    40	    @PreAuthorize("isAuthenticated()")
    41	    public ResponseEntity<List<Map<String, Object>>> searchUsers(
    42	            @RequestParam String query,
    43	            Principal principal) {
    44	        UUID currentUserId = UUID.fromString(principal.getName());
    45	
    46	        List<Map<String, Object>> results = userRepository
    47	                .findTop20ByUsernameContainingIgnoreCaseAndIsDeletedFalse(query)
    48	                .stream()
    49	                .filter(user -> !user.getId().equals(currentUserId))
    50	                .map(user -> Map.<String, Object>of(
    51	                        "id", user.getId().toString(),
    52	                        "username", user.getUsername()
    53	                ))
    54	                .collect(Collectors.toList());
    55	
    56	        return ResponseEntity.ok(results);
    57	    }
    58	
    59	    /**
    60	     * Get user profile by ID.
    61	     */
    62	    @GetMapping("/{userId}")
    63	    @PreAuthorize("isAuthenticated()")

    24	@Configuration
    25	@EnableWebSocketMessageBroker
    26	public class WebSocketConfig implements WebSocketMessageBrokerConfigurer {
    27	
    28	    private final JwtChannelInterceptor jwtChannelInterceptor;
    29	    private final ObjectMapper objectMapper;
    30	
    31	    @Value("${app.cors.allowed-origins:http://localhost:5000,http://127.0.0.1:5000}")
    32	    private String allowedOrigins;
    33	
    34	    public WebSocketConfig(JwtChannelInterceptor jwtChannelInterceptor, ObjectMapper objectMapper) {
    35	        this.jwtChannelInterceptor = jwtChannelInterceptor;
    36	        this.objectMapper = objectMapper;
    37	    }
    38	
    39	    @Override
    40	    public void configureClientInboundChannel(@NonNull ChannelRegistration registration) {
    41	        registration.interceptors(jwtChannelInterceptor);
    42	        registration.taskExecutor().corePoolSize(4).maxPoolSize(10).queueCapacity(100);
    43	    }
    44	
    45	    /**
    46	     * Configure message converters for WebSocket STOMP messages.
    47	     * Uses the application's ObjectMapper (with JavaTimeModule) so that
    48	     * Instant, UUID, and other types serialize/deserialize correctly.
    49	     */
    50	    @Override
    51	    public boolean configureMessageConverters(@NonNull List<MessageConverter> messageConverters) {
    52	        DefaultContentTypeResolver resolver = new DefaultContentTypeResolver();
    53	        resolver.setDefaultMimeType(MimeTypeUtils.APPLICATION_JSON);
    54	
    55	        MappingJackson2MessageConverter converter = new MappingJackson2MessageConverter();
    56	        converter.setObjectMapper(objectMapper);
    57	        converter.setContentTypeResolver(resolver);
    58	
    59	        messageConverters.add(converter);
    60	        return false; // do not add default converters
    61	    }
    62	
    63	    @Override
    64	    public void configureMessageBroker(@NonNull MessageBrokerRegistry registry) {
    65	        registry.enableSimpleBroker("/topic", "/queue")
    66	                .setHeartbeatValue(new long[]{10000, 10000})
    67	            .setTaskScheduler(webSocketHeartbeatTaskScheduler());
    68	        registry.setApplicationDestinationPrefixes("/app");
    69	        registry.setUserDestinationPrefix("/user");
    70	    }
    71	
    72	    @Override
    73	    public void registerStompEndpoints(@NonNull StompEndpointRegistry registry) {
    74	        List<String> origins = Arrays.stream(allowedOrigins.split(","))
    75	                .map(String::trim)
    76	                .filter(origin -> !origin.isEmpty())
    77	                .toList();
    78	
    79	        registry.addEndpoint("/ws-chat")
    80	                .setAllowedOrigins(origins.toArray(new String[0]))
    81	                .withSockJS();
    82	    }
    83	
    84	    @Override
    85	    public void configureClientOutboundChannel(@NonNull ChannelRegistration registration) {
    86	        registration.taskExecutor().corePoolSize(4).maxPoolSize(10).queueCapacity(100);
    87	    }
    88	
    89	    @Override
    90	    public void configureWebSocketTransport(WebSocketTransportRegistration registration) {
    91	        registration.setMessageSizeLimit(128 * 1024);
    92	        registration.setSendBufferSizeLimit(512 * 1024);
    93	        registration.setSendTimeLimit(20000);
    94	    }
    95	
    96	    @Bean(name = "webSocketHeartbeatTaskScheduler")
    97	    public ThreadPoolTaskScheduler webSocketHeartbeatTaskScheduler() {
    98	        ThreadPoolTaskScheduler scheduler = new ThreadPoolTaskScheduler();
    99	        scheduler.setPoolSize(2);
   100	        scheduler.setThreadNamePrefix("ws-heartbeat-");
   101	        scheduler.initialize();
   102	        return scheduler;
   103	    }

     1	package com.example.messaging.websocket.controller;
     2	
     3	import com.example.messaging.conversation.service.ConversationService;
     4	import com.example.messaging.message.cassandra.repository.MessageRepository;
     5	import com.example.messaging.producer.MessageEventPublisher;
     6	import com.example.messaging.websocket.dto.ChatMessage;
     7	import com.example.messaging.websocket.dto.ChatMessageRequest;
     8	import com.example.messaging.websocket.dto.MessageStatusEvent;
     9	import jakarta.validation.Valid;
    10	import org.springframework.lang.NonNull;
    11	import org.springframework.messaging.handler.annotation.MessageMapping;
    12	import org.springframework.messaging.handler.annotation.Payload;
    13	import org.springframework.messaging.simp.SimpMessagingTemplate;
    14	import org.springframework.stereotype.Controller;
    15	
    16	import java.security.Principal;
    17	import java.util.UUID;
    18	
    19	@Controller
    20	public class ChatController {
    21	
    22	    private final SimpMessagingTemplate messagingTemplate;
    23	    private final MessageEventPublisher messageEventPublisher;
    24	    private final ConversationService conversationService;
    25	    private final MessageRepository messageRepository;
    26	
    27	    public ChatController(
    28	            SimpMessagingTemplate messagingTemplate,
    29	            MessageEventPublisher messageEventPublisher,
    30	            ConversationService conversationService,
    31	            MessageRepository messageRepository
    32	    ) {
    33	        this.messagingTemplate = messagingTemplate;
    34	        this.messageEventPublisher = messageEventPublisher;
    35	        this.conversationService = conversationService;
    36	        this.messageRepository = messageRepository;
    37	    }
    38	
    39	    @MessageMapping("/chat.send")
    40	    public void send(@Valid @Payload ChatMessageRequest request, Principal principal) {
    41	        UUID senderId = extractUserId((Principal) principal);
    42	        UUID receiverId = request.getReceiverId();
    43	
    44	        // Find or create conversation using deterministic logic
    45	        String conversationId = conversationService.findOrCreateConversation(senderId, receiverId)
    46	                .getConversationId();
    47	
    48	        // Create message with proper conversationId, messageId, timestamp, and status
    49	        ChatMessage message = ChatMessage.create(
    50	                conversationId,
    51	                senderId,
    52	                receiverId,
    53	                request.getContent()
    54	        );
    55	
    56	        // 1️⃣ Send message to SENDER in real-time (sender sees immediately)
    57	        messagingTemplate.convertAndSendToUser(
    58	                principal.getName(),
    59	                "/queue/messages",
    60	                message
    61	        );
    62	
    63	        // 2️⃣ Send message to RECEIVER in real-time (receiver sees immediately)
    64	        // Convert receiverId to String (principal name format)
    65	        messagingTemplate.convertAndSendToUser(
    66	                receiverId.toString(),
    67	                "/queue/messages",
    68	                message
    69	        );
    70	
    71	        // 3️⃣ Async persistence to Cassandra via RabbitMQ
    72	        messageEventPublisher.publish(message);
    73	    }
    74	
    75	    /**
    76	     * Handle message delivered status update.
    77	     * Called when receiver's client confirms message reception.
    78	     *
    79	     * @param event MessageStatusEvent containing messageId, conversationId, and timestamp
    80	     * @param principal Current user principal
    81	     */
    82	    @MessageMapping("/chat.delivered")
    83	    public void handleDelivered(@Payload MessageStatusEvent event, Principal principal) {
    84	        try {
    85	            UUID receiverId = extractUserId(principal);
    86	
    87	            // ✅ FIXED: Only pass conversationId and messageId (3 parameters, not 4)
    88	            if (event.getConversationId() != null && event.getMessageId() != null) {
    89	                messageRepository.updateStatus(
    90	                        event.getConversationId(),
    91	                        event.getMessageId(),
    92	                        "delivered"
    93	                );
    94	            }
    95	
    96	            // Broadcast delivery confirmation to sender
    97	            MessageStatusEvent deliveryConfirm = new MessageStatusEvent(
    98	                    event.getMessageId(),
    99	                    event.getConversationId(),
   100	                    receiverId,
   101	                    "delivered",
   102	                    event.getCreatedAt()
   103	            );
   104	
   105	            // Send to sender (identified by their principal)
   106	            messagingTemplate.convertAndSendToUser(
   107	                    event.getSenderId().toString(),
   108	                    "/queue/status",
   109	                    deliveryConfirm
   110	            );
   111	
   112	            System.out.println("Message " + event.getMessageId() + " delivered to " + receiverId);
   113	        } catch (Exception e) {
   114	            System.err.println("Error handling delivery confirmation: " + e.getMessage());
   115	        }
   116	    }
   117	
   118	    /**
   119	     * Handle message seen status update.
   120	     * Called when receiver's client confirms message has been read.
   121	     *
   122	     * @param event MessageStatusEvent containing messageId, conversationId, and timestamp
   123	     * @param principal Current user principal
   124	     */
   125	    @MessageMapping("/chat.seen")
   126	    public void handleSeen(@Payload MessageStatusEvent event, Principal principal) {
   127	        try {
   128	            UUID receiverId = extractUserId(principal);
   129	
   130	            // ✅ FIXED: Only pass conversationId and messageId (3 parameters, not 4)
   131	            if (event.getConversationId() != null && event.getMessageId() != null) {
   132	                messageRepository.updateStatus(
   133	                        event.getConversationId(),
   134	                        event.getMessageId(),
   135	                        "seen"
   136	                );
   137	            }
   138	
   139	            // Broadcast seen confirmation to sender
   140	            MessageStatusEvent seenConfirm = new MessageStatusEvent(
   141	                    event.getMessageId(),
   142	                    event.getConversationId(),
   143	                    receiverId,
   144	                    "seen",
   145	                    event.getCreatedAt()
   146	            );
   147	
   148	            // Send to sender (identified by their principal)
   149	            messagingTemplate.convertAndSendToUser(
   150	                    event.getSenderId().toString(),
   151	                    "/queue/status",
   152	                    seenConfirm
   153	            );
   154	
   155	            System.out.println("Message " + event.getMessageId() + " seen by " + receiverId);
   156	        } catch (Exception e) {
   157	            System.err.println("Error handling seen confirmation: " + e.getMessage());
   158	        }
   159	    }
   160	
   161	    private UUID extractUserId(@NonNull Principal principal) {
   162	        return UUID.fromString(principal.getName());
   163	    }
   164	}

     1	package com.example.messaging.websocket.interceptor;
     2	
     3	import com.example.messaging.auth.JwtService;
     4	import io.jsonwebtoken.JwtException;
     5	import org.springframework.lang.NonNull;
     6	import org.springframework.messaging.Message;
     7	import org.springframework.messaging.MessageChannel;
     8	import org.springframework.messaging.simp.stomp.StompCommand;
     9	import org.springframework.messaging.simp.stomp.StompHeaderAccessor;
    10	import org.springframework.messaging.support.ChannelInterceptor;
    11	import org.springframework.messaging.support.MessageHeaderAccessor;
    12	import org.springframework.security.authentication.UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken;
    13	import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;
    14	
    15	import java.security.Principal;
    16	import java.util.Collections;
    17	
    18	@Component
    19	public class JwtChannelInterceptor implements ChannelInterceptor {
    20	
    21	    private final JwtService jwtService;
    22	
    23	    public JwtChannelInterceptor(JwtService jwtService) {
    24	        this.jwtService = jwtService;
    25	    }
    26	
    27	    @Override
    28	    public Message<?> preSend(@NonNull Message<?> message, @NonNull MessageChannel channel) {
    29	
    30	        StompHeaderAccessor accessor =
    31	                MessageHeaderAccessor.getAccessor(message, StompHeaderAccessor.class);
    32	
    33	        if (accessor == null) {
    34	            return message;
    35	        }
    36	
    37	        if (StompCommand.CONNECT.equals(accessor.getCommand())) {
    38	
    39	            String authHeader = accessor.getFirstNativeHeader("Authorization");
    40	
    41	            if (authHeader == null || !authHeader.startsWith("Bearer ")) {
    42	                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Missing Authorization header");
    43	            }
    44	
    45	            String token = authHeader.substring(7);
    46	            String userId = jwtService.validateAndExtractUserId(token);
    47	
    48	            UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken authentication =
    49	                    new UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken(
    50	                            userId,
    51	                            null,
    52	                            Collections.emptyList()
    53	                    );
    54	
    55	            accessor.setUser(authentication);
    56	        }
    57	
    58	        return message;
    59	    }
    60	}
